newsitem.title: USA: Allied Healthcare says strike ends.
newsitem.headline: Allied Healthcare says strike ends.

text.p: Allied Healthcare Products Inc said on Thursday that St. Louis employees represented by the District 9 of the International Association of Machinists voted to ratify a new three-year contract, ending a 19-day strike.
Approximately half of the affected 277 workers will report for work tomorrow, to ready the plant for resumption of full production beginning Monday, the company said.
Bargaining committees from the company and the union reached agreement on the contract Tuesday, Allied said.

The new contract provides for improvements in wages and pension benefits which total 11.65 per cent over three years, Allied said. It also addresses several non-economic issues important to the company and the union employees, the company said.
The company used salaried personnel to maintain production and service to customers during the strike, Allied said.
